name: UNSW Dean's Engineering Equity Scholarship
summary: Yearly scholarship for disadvantaged, under-represented, Indigenous and low-SES students starting a UNSW engineering degree.
key: $15,000 per annum for minimum program duration (up to 5 years).
who: Commencing an eligible UNSW undergraduate engineering degree
Disadvantaged, under-represented, Indigenous or low socio-economic background
how: Apply through UAC for an Equity Scholarship (ES) or EAS; Gateway applicants are considered automatically
catches: 2027 rounds: EAS via UAC by 19 Nov 2026, ES by 10 Dec 2026, with later January and February rounds; offers made through to March 2027
Competitive; meeting the criteria does not guarantee an award
